blocks.text: Westwood Plateau Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Westwood Plateau is a master-planned residential neighbourhood on Eagle Mountain in northern Coquitlam, bordering Port Moody and Anmore to the west, covering 2,309 hectares (5,706 acres) with almost 19,775 people, per the City's Westwood Plateau Community Profile 2019.
Westwood Plateau Village, the local shops, is at the intersection of Parkway Boulevard and Johnson Street, as stated in the City profile.

blocks.text: Westwood Plateau Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The plateau's stock is a master-planned mix: detached-house streets above and townhouse and condo clusters on Plateau Boulevard, Parkway Boulevard, Paddock Drive and Dayanee Springs Boulevard below, all inside the one 2,309-hectare community the City profile describes.

Detached lots here sit in Coquitlam's small-scale residential zones under Zoning Bylaw No. 3000, 1996, and the provincial small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) rules as adopted in Coquitlam apply to them.

blocks.text: Westwood Plateau Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Small-scale housing in Coquitlam can include secondary suites, garden cottages and carriage houses as accessory units, which the City groups with duplexes, triplexes and fourplexes as Small-Scale Residential.

blocks.text: Westwood Plateau Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The plateau borders two other municipalities, Port Moody and Anmore, to the west, so a west-edge address can sit minutes from a different city's tax and permit rules.

The attached clusters sit below the house streets on named boulevards — Plateau Boulevard, Parkway Boulevard, Paddock Drive and Dayanee Springs Boulevard — so "Westwood Plateau" alone does not say whether a listing is a house or a strata unit.

blocks.text: Westwood Plateau Houses: getting around

items.t: Johnson Street is the plateau's spine to the village at Parkway Boulevard, and the community's west side borders Port Moody and Anmore on Eagle Mountain.
The nearest Evergreen Extension (Millennium Line) stations for the wider area are Coquitlam Central and Inlet Centre, below the mountain; Coquitlam Central also has West Coast Express service.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Westwood Plateau

Built on Eagle Mountain from the late 1980s on, Westwood Plateau is a master-planned community with single- family homes, duplexes, townhouses and apartments. Westwood Plateau Village at Parkway and Johnson handles shopping, and the Westwood Plateau Golf & Country Club and Eagle Mountain trails are right there. Families come for the schools, and it’s one of Coquitlam’s go-to areas for a newer home with nature at the door.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Westwood Plateau?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 57 houses listed in Westwood Plateau. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Westwood Plateau a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Westwood Plateau had a sales ratio of 14%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Westwood Plateau from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 40 houses sold in Westwood Plateau over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Westwood Plateau?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

The City's community profile gives 2,309 hectares (5,706 acres) and almost 19,775 people for the master-planned neighbourhood on Eagle Mountain, which is why its house streets and its strata clusters read as separate pockets inside one sub-area name.

Westwood Plateau Village, at the intersection of Parkway Boulevard and Johnson Street, is the local shopping node named in the City profile; the profile is the source for the community's layout of village, schools and parks.

faq.q: What did houses in Westwood Plateau sell for?
faq.a: 57 houses sold in Westwood Plateau between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,740,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Westwood Plateau?
faq.a: The median was 30 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.9% of the last list price (2% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
